rules: Time is stored as exact authoritative timestamps at runtime; fixture/reference scheduling may use day_index plus minute-of-day.
Campus graph adjacency is not zero-time travel.
Travel durations are content/configuration/runtime data and are not silently asserted as canon by this contract.
A missing required travel path makes the transition unresolved/invalid.
Fixed obligations are not silently moved to hide conflicts.
Flexible obligations may move only within authored windows and keep their required duration.
Transit entries are derived schedule blocks and never social/free-time activities.
Uncommitted intervals do not imply the cadet is physically at the previous or next scheduled location.
Species, culture, gender, personality, branch and social status are not generic schedule-priority shortcuts.
Explicit medical/accessibility requirements may constrain timing/location when represented as state.
